text:
Sound wave P has a greater amplitude and a larger wavelength in air than sound wave Q.
How do the loudness and pitch of P compare with the loudness and pitch of Q?
A
P is louder and higher in pitch than Q.
B
P is louder and lower in pitch than Q.
C
P is quieter and higher in pitch than Q.
D
P is quieter and lower in pitch than Q.

options.label: A
options.text: P is louder and higher in pitch than Q.

options.label: B
options.text: P is louder and lower in pitch than Q.

options.label: C
options.text: P is quieter and higher in pitch than Q.

options.label: D
options.text: P is quieter and lower in pitch than Q.
